author: nintendoboy11
body:
IGN: nintendoboy11
Discord (ex. Name#1234): nintendoboy11#4719
Timezone: EDT (EST really)
Why would you like to join the referee team (brief paragraph): 
I want to join the referee team and the event team, in general, because, for all of Minecraft, I've been consumed in events and events is the thing I do best. Being in events is a great way to help out in the community and I want to help. I remember one time when I was playing a match on a server and something was wrong with the scoreboard and the ref was there to calm us down and tell us that it will be fixed soon. I want to be that ref to help out with that because I know the Officials will be busy with fixing said problem. If you accept me, I promise you won't regret it and that I will be a great help to the team. All in all, I want to join the referee team because I want to help out in any way that I can.
Best time of the week?: 
Anytime since I am on summer break, but there may be sometimes where I am not on due to a lot of my family visiting this summer. This usually won't happen on the weekends though.
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself (Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us): 
First, my experience. Previously, I was on the event staff team for Overcast for about three years before the shutdown. I was also a referee here but I was demoted for inactivity. I was busy at that time so I just let that happen. Currently, I am a Sr. Referee and Event Producer for the Stratus Network. Wow, that's a lot of experience. Second, my dedication. From Overcast, you can see I was there from the start of when they started accepting permanent refs to the end of the server. I was always there for Overcast and I will always be here for Avicus if I am accepted. Lastly, my activity. Now, I know my activity here hasn't been the best for this server but I am trying to become more active here by applying for referee. If I am accepted, I promise that I will become more active on this server by joining TS more often, posting on the forums more, and by playing a game or two as well.
Anything else?:
I am a 15 years old kid trying to help out a server and hopefully, you see that I am trying to do that. Y yo hablo español. (un pequeño)* ;).

Thank you for reading, I can't wait to hear your response!
nintendoboy11

*and I speak Spanish. (a little) ;)
